name: collection_stars_map
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished square illustration for an item collection in a children's storybook adventure game. Subject: a beautiful open navy-blue star atlas with two cream parchment pages, fine golden constellation drawings, a small moon emblem on the cover and ribbon bookmark; a few loose celestial chart sheets underneath. Three-quarter view, full entire object centered with 12 percent calm margins. Match premium softly rounded 3D game prop art, tactile leather, brass details and parchment, warm gentle light and subtle contact shadow on a clean quiet warm cream background. The star drawings on the atlas are tiny decorative cover artwork, not a scientific chart. This is only the collectible object; fullscreen educational pages will be separate. No text, no letters, no numbers, no prices, no UI, no fox, no hands, no busy scene. High quality detailed but readable at thumbnail scale.

name: collection_stars_tripod
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One square polished illustration of a wooden telescope tripod, alone, for a children's storybook adventure inventory. Three-quarter view entire object centered with 12 percent calm margins, softly rounded premium 3D game prop rendering, tactile wood and brass. Clean warm cream parchment backdrop, soft warm light, gentle grounding shadow. No text, no labels, no numbers, no UI, no character, no extra tools, no cropped legs.

Premium softly rounded 3D storybook game art, tactile brass and wood, gentle warm light, subtle contact shadow, clean quiet cream parchment backdrop. No text, numbers, specifications, UI, fox, hands, or busy background.

name: collection_stars_ticket
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One square storybook game inventory illustration of a keepsake admission travel ticket for a night trip to an observatory. A single large cream parchment ticket with navy border, small brass-gold moon and telescope pictograms, gently scalloped or perforated short edges, blue ribbon tucked underneath. An inset tiny picture of an observatory under stars signifies the destination. Elegant warm material, softly dimensional premium 3D game prop, full ticket centered with generous calm margins on quiet cream background, soft shadow. The ticket is fictional and decorative: NO text, no numbers, no barcode, no QR, no currency, no dates, no logo, no UI or characters. No compass or coin.

name: collection_sky_orion
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a clear beautiful square night-sky educational illustration of the major stars of Orion for a children's adventure game's collectible star chart. This is a simple SCHEMATIC, not a telescope photograph. Quiet deep navy blue velvety sky, very subtle cosmic haze, faint tiny scattered background specks. EXACTLY SEVEN prominent major stars with thin warm gold connecting segments: Betelgeuse orange at upper-left (normalized x=.24 y=.22), Bellatrix blue-white upper-right (.70,.28), Alnitak at (.40,.52), Alnilam (.49,.48), Mintaka (.58,.44) as three almost collinear close equally spaced bright blue-white BELT stars ascending to the right, Saiph lower-left (.31,.81), Rigel bright blue-white lower-right (.77,.75). The belt stars have a small soft blue-white glow. Connect the belt trio with a clearly highlighted slim gold line; connect Betelgeuse to Bellatrix, Betelgeuse to Alnitak, Bellatrix to Mintaka, Alnitak to Saiph, Mintaka to Rigel, Saiph to Rigel. No additional bright stars or central stars. No constellation person drawing, no telescope, no border, no stars at connector joints besides these seven. IMPORTANT no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no UI; real readable Russian labels are provided by the native app. Smooth restrained attractive astronomical illustration, full sky image, ample margins.

name: collection_sky_ursa_major
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A beautiful square dark navy educational star-chart illustration showing the Big Dipper asterism, which is part of Ursa Major, for a children's storybook game. A simple SCHEMATIC, not a telescope photograph. EXACTLY SEVEN bright warm white principal star points, connected by thin elegant muted gold lines in this specified shape. Three stars form a long gently bent handle from left into a four-star trapezoid bowl on the right. Positions normalized: handle tip Alkaid (.14,.69), Mizar (.27,.47), Alioth (.41,.43), bowl-handle junction Megrez (.57,.47), bowl top-right Dubhe (.86,.38), bowl bottom-right Merak (.84,.66), bowl bottom-left Phecda (.60,.71). Segments only: Alkaid-Mizar-Alioth-Megrez-Dubhe-Merak-Phecda-Megrez. So four stars form a closed bowl and three extra stars extend leftward from its upper-left corner, exactly seven bright stars total. Preserve these positions and connection topology. Background: near-uniform velvety midnight blue with sparse very faint pinprick background stars and slight distant haze, all much dimmer. No bear animal silhouette, no extra bright star on handle or bowl, no moon, no text, labels, numbers, border or UI. Restrained luminous soft light and precise thin lines, plenty of margins. The native app provides the explanatory text.

name: collection_sky_milky_way
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one beautiful square educational night-sky illustration, viewed from Earth within the Milky Way, for a child's collectible star atlas in an adventure game. A broad softly glowing milky band of countless distant stars crosses diagonally from lower left to upper right across a deep navy night sky. Uneven luminous star clouds and clearly visible branching dark dust lanes through the band, subtly denser toward one end. Refined storybook astronomical illustration, natural restrained white, dusty cream and faint blue, not neon rainbow. The sky fills the whole image: no horizon or landscape, no telescope, no people, no planet. This must show the Milky Way as a band seen FROM INSIDE its disk, absolutely not an external face-on spiral galaxy. No connecting constellation lines, no words, no symbols, no labels, no UI, no frame. High detail appropriate for zooming while calm at screen scale.
